counter_layout.position_field: sample bits 11:1 = absolute sample position modulo 2048

qualification.interval: from 63 samples after the last counter channel's acquisition to 63 samples before the capture's end
qualification.observed_only: logged capture losses are not observed time
qualification.capture_rule: capture past the required duration at both ends by the guards and by any logged loss, inside the soak window
qualification.verdict: every verdict states the interval; PASS needs at least required_s observed seconds in it; a shorter interval is NOT RUN

counter_limits: every capture: a capture with a DUT event the bytes show never grades PASS, and each such event is listed on each channel it changes within 63 samples of its sample, unless it masks a planted arm at its sample and the run is void; events that cancel one another, or only move an arm within its tolerance, leave a clean run's bytes

exact classification is claimed only inside a scope: one DUT event with at least 64 clean samples between it and every other event and planted arm, except an excursion whose mask clears its channel number; a one-word corruption 0 to 4 samples from a planted arm; a short slip 1 to 64 samples before a constant-mask excursion whose mask makes no channel number zero or another channel's; any other composition fails or voids the run and may read in other classes
inside the scope, every slip is sized exactly from the decoded position

on every channel the slips a reading reports sum to the shift its closing samples decode; a reading that does not is never taken, and a window no reading balances is one unresolved event at its first sample, never an unbalanced slip

a slip of whole 2048-sample blocks is found within 63 samples and carries located_within, the samples it may have happened at: back over the words that fit both tracks, a corrupted word included where the tracks coincide, and on to the first word that shows it

inside a cluster of events less than 64 samples apart, the slips between them take the smallest sizes the positions allow, and a code bit those sizes leave unexplained reads as a code-bit corruption; the cluster's total is exact

a code-bit corruption less than 64 samples before a slip of whole blocks may make its word the new track's; when every word between them fits both tracks, the bytes are that slip alone at the corrupted word, and read so

where a slip of whole blocks and a code-bit corruption less than 64 samples apart give the same bytes in either order, because the corrupted word is the other track's and only one word between them differs, the corruption reads first and the slip is located after it
a slip followed, within the words that fit both tracks, by a slip of whole blocks gives the bytes of one slip of their sum, and reads so

at a logged planted arm the arm log decides between the readings it tries with the same bytes, taking another only when it has fewer DUT events, or as many and more arms found, so a DUT slip that undoes a slip arm at the next sample reads as the arm and that slip; a DUT slip at a planted slip arm's own sample is one slip of their sum, so unless the DUT slip is whole blocks the arm is missed and the run is void

a one-word corruption on a planted slip arm's own sample or the next one may read first, judged against the offset before the slip, with the slip placed after it within the arm tolerance: the bytes are the same either way

beside a planted flip arm, on its channel, under a slip of whole blocks, the arm's word is the other track's where the two differ, so the bytes may be that slip on the other side of the arm with the arm's code bit one sample over; within the tolerance the arm is found, and located_within bounds the slip of that reading

inside the scope, a corrupted word on a planted slip arm's own sample or the one before it, that is its channel's word at another position at most half a block (1024 samples) from the old or the new track's, reads as a slip to that position and on to the arm's track: the arm is missed and the run is void

a corruption of a planted flip arm's own word, on its channel, combines with the arm's mask, and one beside it under the arm's own mask makes a two-word excursion of that mask: either way the arm is missed and the run is void
a word equal to a neighbouring received word is a repeat

an excursion of two or more words with one constant XOR mask is one corruption at any length, unless its mask clears its channel number, even where slips would produce the same words, and a word on the old track is its return; a one-word event beside it, adjacent or not, a slip before it and a slip at its return are read on their own, and a two-word excursion under two masks that no single offset explains as two one-word corruptions, exactly so inside the scope
outside the scope, a constant-mask excursion over a planted slip arm's sample may void the run although a reading of the bytes finds the arm
outside the scope, an excursion whose mask clears its channel number splits at each word it makes zero, a block start whose code bit is 0, which reads as one sample of silence
a constant-mask corruption that a slip interrupts, or whose words one offset explains up to a slip at its return, reads as the slips its words show

a slip pair whose total is whole blocks and whose displaced words share one XOR mask reads as that bit-flip and a slip of whole blocks beside it, the corruption judged against whichever track gives its mask fewer bits set
a stretch longer than 65536 words without 64 clean samples is graded in pieces; a constant-mask corruption stays a bit-flip with that mask in each
at either end of a capture, words that differ from their track only in the code bit are one unresolved event: a slip of whole blocks or a code-bit corruption, with located_within for the slip
any other slip that 64 clean samples cannot confirm, in a capture's last samples or inside a constant-mask excursion the capture ends in, carries unresolved
nothing outside the qualified interval is proved clean
